full_details: You open Errors, and then you are idle till the end. The middle of the afternoon was other men's. At the reckoning the share was six-and-thirty shillings. Last Saturday was forty, the spring's best. The chest was not counted. Nobody took a hired man's wage out of the share. The Rose had a second Hercules new yesterday. Heminges was gloomy about giants, and he named no sum for that house. At the Jackdaw dinner was sixpence. You told Burbage they have a god in a lion's skin, and that he shall have a looking-glass. He asked when. You said when you have written how he gets there. Garnish, from the next table, gave Kemp's interest as six days, nineteen lines, and a noise like a goose. Kemp was not in the room. You did not show him the book. Heminges said a glass is four shillings, and that Burbage will break one every time. You did not buy one. At home the three sentences were already on the sheet. Under them, unstruck, you wrote send for a glass. The margin stayed empty. You shut the chronicle. Gib got onto the cover, and you left him. The share was put away. The chest was not counted.
one_sentence: You took six-and-thirty shillings, and promised Burbage a looking-glass when you have written how the king gets there.
title: Six-and-thirty shillings, and a glass promised
